title: Loop 005 O002 External Peripheral-Physiology Forecast Replication

dataset.name: CASE — Continuously Annotated Signals of Emotion
dataset.source: Sharma et al. 2019, Scientific Data, DOI 10.1038/s41597-019-0209-0
dataset.annotations: continuous simultaneous valence and arousal at ~20 Hz

role: Independent external replication of the narrow O001 claim for peripheral physiology. No EEG is present, so this does not replicate the central-neural component.
epistemic_scope: No claim of causal necessity, sufficiency, source identity, or consciousness detection.

sampling.unit: non-overlapping prospective windows inside each emotional video
sampling.anchor_rule: Starting 20 s after emotional-video onset, anchors every 10 s, stopping when fewer than 6 future seconds remain.

targets: mean continuous valence during future target window
mean continuous arousal during future target window

models.stimulus_time_prior: video ID + normalized time + prior same-axis report -> Ridge
models.peripheral: video ID + normalized time + prior report + all frozen peripheral features -> Ridge

evaluation.uncertainty: 5000 paired bootstrap resamples of held-out subjects

success_rule: For each axis, peripheral increment is supported only if the subject-bootstrap 95% CI for the primary delta is strictly above zero.
negative_rule: If CI includes zero or is below zero, record NO_PERIPHERAL_INCREMENT for that axis.
integrity_rules: All preprocessing and imputation learned inside training folds only.
No target-window annotation sample may enter predictors.
No post-hoc window or feature changes may rescue a negative primary result.
If full data access/processing cannot be reproduced from the public release, record DATA_ACCESS_OR_PIPELINE_FAIL instead of substituting another representation.
relation_to_O001: O002 is independent-data replication for the peripheral-physiology increment question. Agreement with O001 strengthens generalization; disagreement is preserved and analyzed as task/dataset heterogeneity.
